payload.title: Prepare a separate publication with shared central and internal section routing
payload.description: Owner: dataparade-preparation. As a publication operator I want a new separately owned SaaS publication that receives its central match from an owner-authorized shared Cyclotron and assigns sections using its own integrated Cyclotron. Keep the original four-output central priming independent. Prepare config/code/synthetic tests; never infer actual SaaS account, perspective, domain, criteria, taxonomy or labels. Domain and criteria will be supplied later today. Existing Data Parade product/landing websites and local pod are not authority to replace or migrate them. Deployment, DNS, identity registration and sharing grants require exact scope approval.
